title: Makassar Half Marathon 2027 Review: What the 2026 Race Was Like
seo_title: Makassar Half Marathon Review: Course, Weather, Field
meta_description: Makassar Half Marathon review: 12,400 runners at Losari in 2026, a 1:08:45 winning time, humid pre-dawn air, a four-hour cut-off and race-pack complaints.
dek: What Makassar's city half marathon was like in 2026: a crowded, well-marshalled half marathon from Anjungan Pantai Losari, a one-second finish at the front, saturated air before dawn and a race-pack handout that drew complaints.
verdict: Enter if you want a big, lively half marathon with a city behind it and a generous four-hour cut-off. The 2026 race drew about 12,400 runners over three days, more than half of them from outside Makassar, and crowds lined the route. One returning runner said the course was safe and tidy, with good marshals and no motorbikes. The front of the race is fast: the open men's winner ran 1:08:45. The weak points in 2026 were off the course: race packs and goodie bags drew complaints, and the city itself said there were shortcomings to fix. Expect warm, saturated air, and book a hotel early.

sections.heading: The Course: Out from the Losari Waterfront
paragraphs: The 2026 half marathon started before dawn on Sunday 31 May from Anjungan Pantai Losari, the city's waterfront promenade, and ran 21 km over main roads in the city centre [2]. The organiser said the course was certified by PASI, Indonesia's athletics federation [2].

We did not find a published 2026 route map. The 2025 route started beside the Aryaduta hotel on Jalan Somba Opu, ran along the waterfront past Fort Rotterdam, then inland past the Masjid Raya to a U-turn on Jalan Urip Sumoharjo after the flyover, and came back past Monumen Mandala and Lapangan Hasanuddin to finish where it began [7]. It crossed the Urip Sumoharjo flyover in both directions [7].

sections.heading: The Weather: Saturated Before Dawn
paragraphs: Makassar's Sultan Hasanuddin airport, roughly 18 km north-east of the start, recorded 23°C with a dew point of 23°C, 100% humidity and almost no wind at 5am and 6am on race morning in 2026 [9]. It then warmed quickly: 24°C at 7am, 27°C at 8am, 29°C at 9am and 30°C with 66% humidity at 9.30am [9].

The airport is inland, so the waterfront may have been a degree or two warmer. Either way the air was saturated at the start, and sweat barely cools you in it. Runners still on course after 8am finished in rising heat. Start conservatively and drink early.

sections.heading: Aid Stations and Cut-offs
paragraphs: The 2026 start time and cut-off were not in the reports we read. In 2025 the half marathon flagged off at 5.30am with a four-hour cut-off from gun time, runners had 15 minutes' grace to cross the start, and there were timing checkpoints on the route [7]. The 2027 rules are the same: 5.30am, four hours, water stations at several points on the course, and medical staff plus a team of running doctors in each race [10]. Neither the organiser nor the press gave the number or spacing of the drinks stations.

sections.heading: The Roads: Marshals, Lights and Crowds
paragraphs: A runner from Jakarta, at her second Makassar Half Marathon, said the route was safe and tidy in 2026, with good marshals and no motorbikes on the course [5]. Runners' families and friends gathered at points along the course, and Tribun Timur described cheering along the whole route [2].

Street lighting was the main complaint in 2025. Before the 2026 race the mayor said it was much better, though still being adjusted, and that the city had put route certification, runner insurance and course security in place [6].

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: The front of the race is national class. Immanuel Hutasoit won the open men's half marathon in 1:08:45, and Nofeldi Petingko of Central Sulawesi won the national men's category in 1:08:46 (unofficial), one second behind [1]. Eight men made the podium in the national category alone [1]. We found no women's results; full results are posted on the organiser's site.
Behind the elites this is a mass-participation race: about 12,400 runners took part across the 10K and half marathon weekend in 2026 [1,3].

sections.heading: Race Weekend Logistics
paragraphs: The 2026 event ran over three days, from Friday 29 to Sunday 31 May, at Anjungan Pantai Losari [3,8]. The competitive 5K was dropped that year, a 10K class for 15 to 18-year-olds was added, and about 500 runners took the Triple Medals Challenge, racing on two consecutive days [2]. A shake-out run and a Kid Dash for ages 3 to 12 rounded out the weekend [2].

The race-pack handout went less well. Many runners complained online that the goodie bag was a plain bag, like a minimarket shopping bag, and not what had been promoted [4]. The race director said the bags came from eight local small businesses brought in for the first time, and that supplying about 12,000 runners had stretched them [4]. The Jakarta runner said the 2026 race was far from perfect and that the 2025 edition had been better, with many problems at pack distribution [5]. The mayor said afterwards that there were shortcomings and that the city would fix them [3].

More than half the field came from outside Makassar, and hotels near the venue were nearly full days before the race [3,6]. In 2026 the city's parking company set flat event rates of Rp3,000 for a motorbike and Rp5,000 for a car, with about 12 parking areas around the start [8].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2027 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a big, well-supported half marathon with crowds, a fast front end and a Makassar food weekend attached. The four-hour cut-off suits first-timers, and you can pair the Saturday 10K with the Sunday half.
Think twice if smooth race-pack logistics matter to you, or if you want cool air for a personal best.

The 2027 race is on Sunday 30 May, with the 10K on Saturday 29 May [10]. The city wants 12,000 runners in 2027 and international-standard organisation by 2028 [11]. Book accommodation near Losari early.
Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on local news reports from race weekend, the organiser's race rules, the 2025 route and rules, and airport weather records.

faqs.question: How fast do you need to be to win the Makassar Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: Very fast. In 2026 Immanuel Hutasoit won the open men's half marathon in 1:08:45, and Nofeldi Petingko won the national men's category in 1:08:46 (unofficial), one second behind. Women's winning times were not in the reports we read; full results are linked from the organiser's site.

faqs.question: How hot and humid is the Makassar Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: Humid at the start and hot by the finish for slower runners. On race morning in 2026 Makassar airport recorded 23°C with 100% humidity and almost no wind at 5am and 6am. It reached 27°C at 8am and 30°C at 9.30am, near the four-hour cut-off. Start conservatively and drink at every station.

faqs.question: What is the cut-off at the Makassar Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: Four hours for the half marathon and two hours for the 10K, counted from gun time, under both the 2025 and 2027 rules. The half marathon flags off at 5.30am, and runners have 15 minutes' grace to cross the start line. Later starters must join the next race or are marked did not start.

faqs.question: What went wrong at the 2026 Makassar Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: Mostly the race packs. Many runners complained that the goodie bag was a plain shopping-style bag, not what had been promoted, and a returning runner said pack distribution had many problems. The organiser blamed stretched local suppliers. On the course itself, runners reported safe roads and good marshals, and the city promised to fix the shortcomings.

faqs.question: Where should you stay for the Makassar Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: As close to Anjungan Pantai Losari as you can, and book early. In 2026 more than half of about 12,400 runners came from outside Makassar, and the mayor said hotels near the venue were almost fully booked days before the race. The start is on the city's waterfront, near the Aryaduta and Fort Rotterdam.

editorial_notes: Written 2026-11-02 about the previous edition (half marathon on 31 May 2026; the event ran 29 to 31 May). The official 2026 results are on RaceTec, linked from the organiser's site, but behind a bot check, so only the two men's winning times reported by Tribun Timur are used; no women's results were read. No 2026 route map or 2026 start time was found: the course paragraph uses the 2025 route and the cut-off paragraph the 2025 and 2027 rules, both labelled. Weather is from Makassar airport METAR, about 18 km from the start; there were no reports between 1.30am and 5am. The 2026 race director was from Idea Race, while the 2027 site names DEE Management; the change is not explained in what we read. Runners quoted are not named. Celebesmedia articles about the 2026 race would not load. Web search budget ran out, so the review relies on news-site tag pages and direct fetches. No rating.
